mapper.select: SELECT id, jar_key, name, group_id, artifact_id, version, jar_type, source, description, content_hash, created_at, updated_at FROM yglue_jar_library WHERE jar_key = #{jarKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO yglue_jar_library (jar_key, name, group_id, artifact_id, version, jar_type, source, description, content_hash) VALUES (#{jarKey}, #{name}, #{groupId}, #{artifactId}, #{version}, #{jarType}, #{source}, #{description}, #{contentHash})
mapper.update: UPDATE yglue_jar_library SET name = #{name}, group_id = #{groupId}, artifact_id = #{artifactId}, version = #{version}, jar_type = #{jarType}, source = #{source}, description = #{description}, content_hash= #{contentHash} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO yglue_jar_library_class (jar_id, qualified_name, simple_name, package_name, kind, doc) VALUES (#{jarId}, #{qualifiedName}, #{simpleName}, #{packageName}, #{kind}, #{doc})
INSERT INTO yglue_jar_library_class_field (class_id, name, type, is_static) VALUES (#{classId}, #{name}, #{type}, #{static})
INSERT INTO yglue_jar_library_class_method (class_id, name, return_type, is_static, parameters_json) VALUES (#{classId}, #{name}, #{returnType}, #{static}, #{parametersJson})
